'''Han Zuilhof''' (born 1965) holds the chair of [[organic chemistry]] at [[Wageningen University]]. His interests focus on organic reactions that work efficiently under very mild conditions, surface-bound (bio-)[[organic chemistry]] and the development of [[analytical chemistry]] tools.

Zuilhof obtained an M.Sc. in [[chemistry]] and M.A. in [[philosophy]] from [[Leiden University]]. After a Ph.D. in organic chemistry ([[Leiden University]], 1994) and postdoctoral work at the [[University of Rochester]] and [[Columbia University]], he joined the faculty at [[Wageningen University & Research|Wageningen University]]. He has been a professor of organic chemistry since 2007. He was an adjunct professor of chemical engineering at [[King Abdulaziz University]] in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (2011-2022). He is a Perennial Distinguished Guest Professor of [[molecular science and medicinal chemistry]] at the school of pharmaceutical science and technology (SPST) at [[Tianjin University]], [[China]] since 2014, and obtained the Top-Talent Distinguished Professorship of Molecular Science at [[Jiaxing University]], [[China]] in 2023. In 2024, he won the Top-Talent Award of [[Zhejiang Province]], [[China]], to set up a center for [[click chemistry]] in materials science.

He serves/served on the editorial advisory boards of [[Langmuir (journal)|''Langmuir'']], [http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/10.1002/%28ISSN%292196-7350 ''Advanced Materials Interfaces''] and ''[[Applied Surface Science]]'' and was a senior editor of ''Langmuir'' from 2016 to 2020.<ref>{{cite tweet|user=ACS_Langmuir|author=Langmuir|number=772706042530631680|date=5 September 2016|title=EIC Francoise Winnik is happy to welcome Han Zuilhof as a Senior Editor of Langmuir}}</ref>  In 2021, he was awarded, amongst others with [[Barry Sharpless]] and [[John Moses (chemist)|John Moses]], the Robert Robinson Award in Synthetic Organic Chemistry by the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] for contributions to [[click chemistry]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Multidimensional Click Chemistry {{!}} 2021 Organic Division Horizon Prize: Robert Robinson Award in Synthetic Organic Chemistry winner |url=https://www.rsc.org/prizes-funding/prizes/2021-winners/multidimensional-click-chemistry-team/#undefined |access-date=2024-08-18 |website=Royal Society of Chemistry |language=en-GB}}</ref> He is also the founder (2011) of a spin-off company, [[Surfix]].<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.wageningenur.nl/en/Persons/prof.dr.-JT-Han-Zuilhof.htm | title=Prof.dr. JT (Han) Zuilhof| date=2012-09-04}}</ref>
